protocol.order: AB / BA alternating, serial, no competing build during provider measurements
protocol.admission: offline request client only; real response body/SSE/adapter/EventStream
protocol.input: pre-encoded before profiling; string N/2N/4N and delta-size/wide-container variants
protocol.parseCounts: JSON.parse calls whose argument is the fixture raw tool JSON; excludes SSE JSON decode; baseline partial-json/repair scans not included, so this is a lower bound
protocol.scanner: UTF-16 code units, separately from input UTF-8 bytes; scalar preview inspections bounded to 64 per append
protocol.cpu: Windows quantization makes short CPU observations noisy, including zero; wall p95 and allocation used for comparisons
protocol.downstream: unchanged downstream lane, structural/GC regression gates only; paced benchmark overlapped a build, so its timing is not an A/B performance claim
protocol.gc: keep caller stream/final result alive; incomplete result intentionally owns its preview on abort/error, while parser and private scratch are released
protocol.limits: no new depth/byte product cap; same runtime string representability and request output scope; no pool
